foil.title: Energy repricing risk from Middle East security escalation state
foil.scenario_short: Middle East security escalation state will sustain energy repricing pressure near 58% over 30 days, driven by 6 urgent critical signals and 72% state confirmation of energy supply shock transmission.
foil.perspective_strategic: The 58% pressure and 72% state confirmation indicate a stable but elevated risk of energy repricing through supply shock, with the strongest transmission path running through energy supply shock across 1 edge toward Energy.

foil.actor_lens: Commodity traders: Price whether stress in Middle East becomes durable over the 30d. Rebalance positions if the probability path moves away from 58%.
foil.top_signal: Middle East security escalation state is feeding energy repricing through energy supply shock, with 58% pressure and 72% state confirmation
